steps.title: Shorten Earth's addresses
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `more flash:fleet-addresses.txt`. Shorten both addresses with the two rules and hand them in: `submit A=...` and `submit B=...`.

steps.title: Give Skyport an IPv6 address
steps.body: Go to `configure terminal`. Turn on IPv6 routing with `ipv6 unicast-routing`. Then `interface g0/0` and `ipv6 address 2001:db8:c0de:10::1/64`. Type `end` and check with `show ipv6 interface brief`: you get a global address and a link-local one for free.

objectives.label: Checked the result with show ipv6 interface brief

steps.title: Read the visitor log
steps.body: Read `more flash:visitors.txt`. Name the ship with a unique local address (`submit ULA=SHIP-n`) and the one showing only a link-local address (`submit LINK=SHIP-n`).
